claims: Chuck Norris passed away on March 20, 2026.
Chuck Norris passed away at age 86.
Chuck Norris had a sudden hospitalization for a medical emergency on the island of Kauai, Hawaii.
Chuck Norris was on vacation at his Hawaii home when the incident occurred.
Chuck Norris was surrounded by family when the incident occurred, according to reports.
Chuck Norris is an actor and martial artist.
Chuck Norris is known for "Walker, Texas Ranger."
TMZ reports initially indicated Chuck Norris was hospitalized in Kauai, Hawaii, after a medical emergency.
News of Chuck Norris's passing emerged shortly after.
Chuck Norris celebrated his birthday on March 10.
Chuck Norris posted a video of himself training just before the incident.
The incident took place near Chuck Norris's home on Kauai's North Shore.
Chuck Norris has owned his home on Kauai's North Shore since 2015.
Chuck Norris's family noted that he was surrounded by loved ones at the time of his passing, according to fox61.com and YouTube.
The specific cause of the medical emergency was not disclosed, according to WCNC and ABC10.
